sloka: वासोभिर्बहुसाहस्रैर्यो महात्मा पुरोचित:।मृगाजिने सोऽयमिह प्रवस्ते धर्ममाचरन् ॥ २.९९.३२॥
transliteration: vāsobhirbahusāhasrairyo mahātmā purocita:।mṛgājine so'yamiha pravaste dharmamācaran ॥ 2.99.32॥

translations.english: Such magnanimous Rama, a follower of dharma, accustomed to be attired in thousands of dresses in the past now clad in two deer skins, is practising righteousness.
